notes: This candidate verifies active/passive state replacement for the complete adapter-configured ordinary object-class attribute set. The federate first subscribes passively through the standard IEEE 1516.1-2025 subscribeObjectClassAttributes service, then invokes that same service for the same attributes with active=true. A fresh IEEE 1516.2-2025 MIM report is the oracle for the resulting active state and exact attribute set. Provider, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, attribute names, and update-rate name come from the adapter.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void subscribeObjectClassAttributes( ObjectClassHandle const & objectClass, AttributeHandleSet const & attributes, bool active = true, std::wstring const & updateRateDesignator = L"") = 0
